title: John Carmack Keynote - Quakecon 2013
summary: John Carmack's roughly three-hour QuakeCon 2013 keynote, delivered from a few bullet points. Topics include his Haskell experiments with functional programming and static typing, game state, and cloud gaming.
why: Recommended to Carmack fans as the keynote with his functional programming adventures and for his fluent, wide-ranging talk.

quote.text: Watch one of his keynotes. He sits down with some bullet points on a tablet and then talks for three hours
